thread:
Priya: quick sync — finalizing release notes for v2.3.1, targeting a short staging window tonight 23:30-00:00 PT. can ops review the pin + rollback plan?
Kevin: on it. which routes are we pinning?
Priya: pin by route: /generate -> v2.3.1, /embed -> v2.2.9 (immutable). snippet in the draft: `pin: { '/generate': 'v2.3.1' }`
Chris: saw the draft. add canary at 5% for first 10m then 25% for 20m before full. keep latency SLO check during canary.
Jasmine: ops check: what are abort criteria?
Priya: abort if 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR 95th latency increase > 100ms vs baseline. also auto-fallback to v2.2.9 if canary fails.
Kevin: confirmed. I'll create a deploybot pin command. will post bot cue.
deploy-bot: @channel pin request received for /generate -> v2.3.1; scheduled staging pin at 2026-03-23T23:30:00-07:00. To abort run `/deploybot rollback --thread 1790011224`
Chris: quick note for release notes: call out kernel selection tweak (attention-fuse) and batching heuristic change. small perf win but potential edge-case on long prompts.
Priya: yep adding a short note: "Kernel: attention-fuse enabled; expect ~6-8% token throughput improvement. Watch prompts >4k tokens."
Jasmine: add an owner for the window. Priya, can you own first 30m?
Priya: I can own 23:30-00:00. Kevin will own rollback if needed.
Kevin: I'll be on stand-by. setting pager rotation and quiet-window flag.
Chris: confirm logging: increase `inference.trace` to DEBUG for canary routes for 30m. we can revert after.
Priya: added to notes and pinned doc: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/v2.3.1 (short blurb + ops checklist)
Jasmine: legal / comms: short internal blurb ready? we'll blast to #all-hands after we get green from canary.
Priya: draft blurb in doc; short, 2 bullets and link to detailed notes.
Kevin: deploy-bot will emit stage events. I'll watch the canary dashboard and call abort if thresholds hit.
deploy-bot: Stage event: CANARY_START /generate @ 2026-03-23T23:30:00-07:00 5% traffic. Health checks active.
Chris: seeing traces good so far, latency inline with baseline (+10ms).
Priya: 10m check-in: all green. moving to 25% for 20m.
Kevin: still green. no 5xx spikes.
Jasmine: thanks team — if all stays green we'll send internal announce at 00:10 PT and unpin after 01:00.
Priya: noted. final line in notes: rollback command and contact list included.
Kevin: logged postmortem template entry in the doc in case we need it.
Priya: closing thread — will post final announce and update #all-hands. :rocket:
